description: discover() claims to fetch 'LIVE open contests' but its regex captures EVERY audit that has a USDC pool printed on code4rena's /audits index — which is overwhelmingly the COMPLETED/closed-audit archive, not the active set. The proof is the script's own output state/contests.json: the top entry is '2025-09-monad' ($500,000), followed by '2025-08-solana-foundation', '2025-06-chainlink-rewards', etc. Today is 2026-06-30, so the #1 'live' contest is ~10 months old and long closed. code4rena audit windows are ~1-3 weeks, so NONE of these 47 (even the newest '2026-04-*') are plausibly still open for submission. There is no date filter, no status=active filter, and no open/closed discrimination anywhere. The slot reports '47 live code4rena contests (top: ...$500000)' (run.sh:39) which is false. Every downstream step (execute picks contests[0]) then targets a dead contest that cannot be submitted to even if an account existed.
